title: Drive-In: Site performance
description: The app's load, throughput, latency and errors, Blazor sessions, outbound calls, the database and the .NET runtime.

panels.title: Open sessions
panels.description: Blazor circuits: browser tabs on an interactive page.

panels.title: Latency
panels.description: Server time per request, leaving out the Blazor circuit's long-lived connection.

panels.title: Errors logged
panels.description: Error and critical log messages by logger. Most failures in interactive pages show up here, not as 5xx. Find them with `docker compose logs web`.

panels.title: Unhandled exceptions
panels.description: Exceptions that reached ASP.NET Core's exception handler (static pages, endpoints).

panels.title: Payments reconciled
panels.description: Charges whose outcome checkout never heard (a timeout, or a crash mid-charge), settled later with the processor by PaymentReconcileService or a Stripe webhook: completed (sold or issued) or released (undone).

panels.title: Blazor circuits
panels.description: Active circuits hold server memory; connected ones have a live connection (a tab can be active but briefly disconnected).

panels.title: Thread pool
panels.description: A growing queue means requests are waiting for a thread (often sync-over-async or a slow dependency).
